text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty fired PD-EMBEDS-789 -> PROD-EMBEDS queue surge in prod-east. Severity: P1. Symptoms: embeddings backlog + 5xx spike (~3.2%). Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-EMBEDS-789

sarah: taking this. I'm oncall and will join a quick bridge in ~2m. @devon can you pull autoscaler/events + redis metrics?

devon: ack, looking now. tailing logs: ```kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embed-processor --since=10m```

devon: seeing a bunch of Redis TIMEOUT errors around 12:10 and slow consumer on worker-3. Starting a quick bump to replicas=6 to relieve backlog. rolling update kicked off.

alice: ack — I'll prep customer comms. which customers are impacted (enterprise vs self-serve)?

sarah: quick check @matt — are dedicated pools healthy? Could route high-tier customers to dedicated to reduce impact.

matt: dedicated GPUs are healthy, no capacity alarms. Current routing policy still sending everything to shared pool. I can flip enterprise->dedicated if we want.

sarah: do it for enterprise only. alice, wait for me to confirm before sending comms.

matt: flipped routing for tag:customer=enterprise -> dedicated-pool. verifying traffic shift now.

devon: replica bump finished, pods stabilized. 5xx down to ~0.9% from 3.2%. queue length reduced by ~50%. still seeing a stuck consumer on worker-3.

sarah: I'll cordon + restart worker-3 now to force reconnect to Redis and reload KV cache.

devon: restarted worker-3, logs look clean. drain rate back to expected throughput. redis timeouts no longer spiking.

alice: PSA sent to affected customers: "We saw transient embeddings delays; we routed enterprise traffic to dedicated capacity and restarted a worker. Service is returning to normal; we'll follow up with a post-incident note."

incident-bot: PD-EMBEDS-789 acknowledged by sarah. incident-bot note: event_id=98765

alice: should we open a follow-up ticket for runbook/alerts?

sarah: yes. Action items: 1) tighten autoscaler scale-up thresholds for emb-processor, 2) alert on Redis TIMEOUT >0.5% for 5m, 3) add a runbook step for routing enterprise->dedicated and a quick checklist for worker restarts. I'll create the ticket after this thread.

matt: monitoring for 10m then I'll hand off back to sarah.

sarah: resolved — queue drained and 5xx back to baseline. I'll close PD after 10m stable. great work team :rocket:
